slide1_title: List Your Craft in 5 Simple Steps
slide1_desc: KalaSetu makes it effortless to bring your handmade art to buyers across India and the globe. No computer skills needed!
slide1_tip: You can speak in your mother tongue anytime. KalaSetu is built for artisans first.
slide2_desc: Capture your craft in bright, natural morning sunlight. Place it on a clean, solid sheet or floor mat so details shine.
slide2_tip: Add 2 to 3 different angles (front, back, and close-up) to build deep trust with online buyers.
slide3_desc: Simply tap the microphone and speak naturally. Describe the tradition, natural materials, and hours poured into crafting it.
slide3_tip: Talk in Hindi, Tamil, Bengali, or English. KalaSetu's AI listens and writes beautifully for you.
slide4_desc: Our AI automatically cleans your photo lighting, suggests engaging titles, craft stories, categories, and marketplace tags.
slide4_tip: You always have 100% control. You can review and edit any title, story, or tag before publishing.
slide5_desc: Input your raw materials cost and crafting hours. Our algorithm calculates a fair selling price that honors your hard work.
slide5_tip: Never undersell your craft again. KalaSetu suggests optimal pricing bands based on live market demand.
slide6_desc: Slow or no village network? No problem at all! Save your drafts offline and KalaSetu will automatically sync when connected.
slide6_tip: Your progress is automatically saved. You will never lose an unfinished listing draft.
slide7_desc: Join master artisans turning heritage craft traditions into sustainable, fair livelihoods with KalaSetu.
slide7_tip: Ready to create your first listing? Tap below to open the studio camera and get started!
